title: Abelian sheaf cohomology vanishes on profinite topological spaces
statement: Let $X$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological space (a profinite space). For every abelian sheaf $G$ on the site of open subsets of $X$ with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and every integer $q>0$, $H^q(X,G)=0$, where cohomology is the right derived functor of global sections [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].
